text:
Evelyn: quick pass on dark-mode dashboard mocks. main issues: chart fills wash out lines at small sizes, legend items blend into panels, and code blocks look faded on 11px. attaching screenshots in the design doc.

Mark: saw them — agree on fills. idea: use 1px stroke + 14% fill instead of heavy blur. keeps area readable and preserves line contrast.

Yuki: also noticed the heatmap gradient (purple->teal) is tough for protan/deutan. proposing an alternate diverging set (indigo -> amber). will generate Coblis previews.

Omar: copy nit: label says "Low motion" but toggles animations. change to "Reduce animations" and tooltip: "Disable non-essential chart motion for accessibility."

Clara: code blocks failing contrast at 11px. options: bump console font to 12px or darken bg. prefer darken bg to avoid layout shifts. suggested bg `#0b0f12` and text `#e6eef6`.

Evelyn: good split — owners: Mark (chart stroke + demo), Yuki (palettes & colorblind previews), Clara (code block contrast), Omar (copy). timeline: try to land chart + code this sprint.

Mark: mock PR inbound with three palette variants and before/after toggle in the doc. will include GIF of toggle.

Yuki: uploaded Coblis images and a ColorBrewer set for testing. noticed legend separators are at 6% alpha — raise to 12% or add subtle backing.

A11yBot: automated scan queued: run 1732100000-a11y. Expected results in ~2m.

Clara: I'll implement the code bg change in a branch and add a storybook entry for 11px & 12px screenshots.

Evelyn: perfect. once PRs land let's run a final a11y pass and hand off tokens to platform. thanks all. :thumbsup:
